findings.finding: FY26 numbers were pre-released in line on 2026-07-21 (revenue £57.7m vs £57.6m, adj. EBITDA £12.1m vs £12.0m, net cash £21.0m vs £20.4m); the audited print should restate them, carrying no news on those lines.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prior finals after a pre-release: 2025-10-08 0.0%, 2024-10-09 +4.09%, 2023-10-11 -0.61%; the trading updates carried the moves (2025-07-22 +7.96%, 2026-07-21 +4.85%).
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the stock rose 4.85% on the update and has held above that level; filed at 0 to record that the period line is exhausted.
findings.independence: Edison 2026-07-31 quotes the same consensus and the pre-release https://www.edisongroup.com/research/fy26-trading-statement/BM-3766/

findings.finding: Exit total ACV of £53.7m (+27%), organic Cloud ACV +24%, AI-product sales ~3x and a 'record' FY27 opening pipeline, plus a full-year Jadu contribution (acquired December 2025), sit comfortably against LSEG FY27e revenue of £67.2m (+16.5%), making an 'in line or ahead' FY27 current-trading statement more likely than a cautious one.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Netcall's outlook statements have been qualitative ('Board remains confident'); the finals that carried them moved 0.0% (2025) and +4.09% (2024). The forward-looking July trading updates moved +7.96% and +4.85%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the ACV and pipeline were public in July. What is not public is the first current-trading read on FY27 Q1 (July-September); if the market had priced an upgrade the shares would trade above Edison's 'undemanding' EV/EBITDA framing and the 150-155p broker targets would be closer than 125p. Lands inside expectations, so sized small.
findings.independence: Edison consensus table (FY27e £67.2m / £14.8m) https://www.edisongroup.com/research/fy26-trading-statement/BM-3766/ ; H1 FY26 record order book £92.4m https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/netcall--net/half-year-report/9456909

findings.finding: BGF Investment Management, a long-standing holder, sold from 4.94% to 3.991% (crossing on 2026-09-28, a 1.08m-share day) and still holds 6.8m shares — roughly 35 days of median turnover — an active seller likely to supply stock into any results-day strength.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior BGF selling episode measured; the 2026-09-17 1.58m-share block and 2026-09-28 1.08m-share day both printed with the price flat, consistent with a seller absorbing upside.
findings.why_not_priced: The disclosure is public, but the residual 6.8m-share stake relative to ~185k shares/day of turnover is a capacity constraint, not an information item; the flat 125p print since 2026-09-28 on heavy volume is what an unfinished seller looks like.
findings.independence: Yahoo daily volume 2026-09-17 1,578,497 and 2026-09-28 1,075,691 with the price unchanged https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/NET.L?range=3mo&interval=1d

findings.finding: The step-up that makes the 20-day run-up (113p to 118.5p on 400k shares) came on 2026-09-10, the day Accel-KKR bid 74.7% premium for AIM software peer Eleco (£208m, Netcall's size), so the run-up reads as takeover read-across rather than results anticipation and will not be confirmed by an in-line print.
findings.why_not_priced: Inference only: the date coincidence is sourced, the causal link is not. If the run-up were results anticipation it would have come after the 2026-09-29 Notice of Results; instead price has been flat at 125p since 2026-09-28.
